description: Lessons of the AgentPlannerBasics examples. Each proposal is a workflow DSL v2 plan exactly as an LLM would return it (or a bad one, as a careless or manipulated model might return it); GeoKernel validates every proposal the same way.
groundingNotes: Synthetic neighbourhood in EPSG:4326. buildings: ref, use (residential, commercial, mixed, public), floors, year_built, status (in use, vacant, demolished). schools: name, level, students. parks: name, trees. streets: name, class (primary, secondary, residential), lanes.

basic.title: A plan that reads data and changes the view
basic.request: Show the buildings within 150 m of a school in red

rejected.title: A chat answer instead of a plan
rejected.why: Only a JSON workflow object is accepted; prose never reaches the executor.
rejected.proposal: Sure! I will buffer the schools by 150 m and select the buildings around them.

rejected.title: An operation outside the catalog
rejected.why: Operations come from a fixed allow-list; there is no way to run code.

rejected.title: An extra parameter carrying SQL
rejected.why: Every parameter of every operation is declared; unknown ones are refused.

rejected.title: SQL hidden in an attribute filter
rejected.why: Filters use a small expression language without writes; it is parsed before anything runs.

rejected.title: A reference to a step that does not exist
rejected.why: A step can only use the output of an earlier step of the same plan.

rejected.title: The model claims the user confirmed
rejected.why: Confirmation comes from the host, never from the proposal.

confirm.title: Changing data needs confirmation of this exact plan
confirm.request: Flag the buildings built before 1975 near the primary avenue for inspection
confirm.changedTitle: The same plan with one value changed (inspection = demolish)
